defaults.summary: memcached, an in-memory key-value cache without sign-in.

notes.name: access
notes.text: memcached asks for no credentials: any account on this machine can reach its port and read or change every key, so keep secrets out of it.

notes.name: clients
notes.text: Stack's PHP has no memcached extension, so PHP code and Laravel's memcached cache store cannot use this service; give a Laravel site a valkey service (type: redis) for its cache instead. Clients of other languages, such as Node, Python or Go, connect to MEMCACHED_HOST and MEMCACHED_PORT.

notes.name: memory
notes.text: It listens on TCP only, holds at most 64 MiB, evicting the least recently used keys beyond that, and loses every key when it stops.

notes.name: group_rename
notes.text: A group rename does not carry its keys: the cache starts empty under the new name, so the application fills it again, and the old data directory stays until stack prune --data removes it.

recipes.title: A cache for the group
recipes.gives: Gives MEMCACHED_HOST and MEMCACHED_PORT, and the same two prefixed CACHE_, for clients such as Node, Python or Go; Stack's PHP cannot use it.

recipes.title: Two caches, one holding the bare names
recipes.gives: Gives MEMCACHED_HOST and MEMCACHED_PORT to cache, the default, and both again prefixed CACHE_ or SESSIONS_ for each, such as SESSIONS_MEMCACHED_PORT.
